title: Final Probability
description: Essential Criteria: The final probability of finding the total spin to be zero must be correctly calculated as 1/4.

title: Measurement Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly interpret the measurement of spin states and how they relate to the total spin.

title: State Representation
description: Important Criteria: The student must express the states of the particles correctly in terms of the relevant spin bases.

title: Inner Product Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the inner product between the states must be shown and correctly computed.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or miscalculating the inner products.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide alternative methods or reasoning for arriving at the final probability.
